name: Zhonghe Brand Yunjigou Technology Inc.
summary: Presently, Zhonghe Brand Yunjigou Technology Inc. does not engage in significant business activities. Its past endeavors included researching and developing a concept for an event center. The company, which changed its name from Carriage House Event Center, Inc. to Zhonghe Brand Yunjigou Technology Inc. in May 2025, was established in 2010. Headquartered in Guangzhou, China, it operates as a subsidiary of Zhonghe Brand Ltd.
